summary.one_line: The six new diary entries and archive recipe remain accurate after clarifying BOM removal and LF normalization.

purpose.evidence: Read all 13 changed Markdown paths. Six new paired diary entries preserve research process and corrections, while topical pages point readers to the relevant entries. The ArmyWnd page now gives readers a read-only way to inspect the named installed resource; the Universe build page gives a downloadable archive-comparison table and recount recipe. The changes continue documentation without claiming a finished SDK, assessor or universal predictor.

structure.evidence: The diary pair retains its earlier six entries and appends six additional dated records before the standing recording rules. Topical pages link to stable diary anchors for ArmyWnd, projection range/lifecycle, assessor inputs and archive inventory. The two code recipes sit beside the claims they check, while detailed historical outcomes remain in the diary. The CSV is a single canonical artifact linked from formats/build and the diary, rather than copied into articles.

specificity.evidence: Independently checked tracked archive-diff.csv: 732359 bytes, LF-only, SHA-256 81115018610632c94b9db9566b28cc85afa3e42b76cf2c37e3ffbfc4a5af4299, six named columns and 6930 records. Recount gave Universe_mod.pak added4047/changed1075/same37 (5159 total) and universe_mod_texts_ru.pak added942/changed605/same224 (1771 total), matching both pages. Diary preserves the original 1074/4048 comparison-base correction, the 0→47→51 renderer counter, five-battle 3/4/7/1/1 projection counts, 16-field range control, and pack_15 3/7 versus another run 0/7 as distinct results. Final correction verifies the public CSV has no UTF-8 BOM and 6931 LF line endings; the documented source size 739293 minus public 732359 is 6934 bytes, exactly three BOM bytes plus one removed CR for each of 6931 lines.

reproducibility.evidence: The ArmyWnd recipe names data.pak member ArmyWnd.(WindowSimple).xdb and prints byte hash, Visible and Size. Parent reports running the exact fenced Python against the pinned installed archive and obtaining 30a503de.../true/197 110; the displayed values match the September 21 resource research. The CSV recount recipe can run from its downloaded file; I independently reproduced its counts. These are resource/file checks, not a fresh live game run. Parent reports build/check, all 12 browser tests, secret scan and 30 targeted viewport checks passing; local CSV download returned the same 732359-byte hash.

evidence.evidence: Compared new diary claims with the bounded research notes: ArmyWnd three hashes and Visible/size, temporary renderer counter 0/47/51 with no show/hide attribution, 16 authored fields with 2/3 movement cost and speed×2 budget, two five-battle processes with historical DLL hash 8290957f..., assessor Tk 8.6.12/synthetic OCR rather than real game-font validation, and archive comparison-base correction. New entries state raw logs and historical DLL are unpublished and do not re-label retrospective summaries as original dumps. I did not scan a game/profile, rerun native code, or independently recheck installed XDB; the report uses the parent-run recipe and primary research record for those values. NOTICE and both diary translations now say publication removed the UTF-8 BOM as well as normalizing CRLF to LF. I independently checked the public artifact has no BOM, no CRLF, 6931 LF, unchanged 6930 records and the same documented SHA-256. Parent supplied the source-file BOM/CRLF measurement; I did not scan an unspecified private CSV path.

applicability.evidence: Pages scope resource hashes, native addresses and controls to the pinned Universe installation. ArmyWnd's instance size is distinguished from its Shared resource's 0×0 fields; Visible=true is not treated as proof of a populated UI. Projection range and five-battle checks do not imply accurate placement across armies; assessor button/OCR controls do not imply a victory model. Archive comparison is explicitly against four local baselines that were not authenticated as clean stock ToE, and report selection rules are not claimed as game mount precedence.

translations.evidence: Compared all six new RU/EN diary entries and the paired topical additions: ArmyWnd hashes/size, 0→47→51 counter caveat, 16-field movement cost, five-battle projection sequence, Tk/OCR limits, CSV counts/hash and baseline correction agree. RU/EN ArmyWnd and CSV recipes are equivalent, and all diary anchor links have counterparts. Existing reciprocal metadata and local links are covered by parent-reported check; this is not a professional translation audit. Round2 provenance wording is parallel in RU and EN: both diary entries and NOTICE say BOM removal plus LF normalization, with original rows/fields preserved.

maintenance.evidence: NOTICE describes archive-diff.csv as project-generated metadata without game resource bytes, and the file scan found no private-path marker. The diary continues to preserve dated experimental history and links to source data/code while flagging unpublished originals. The CSV has a documented download hash based on published LF bytes, consistent with the prior CRLF correction rule. review:info lists exactly these 13 Markdown paths; no source or data file was edited by this reviewer. The correction updates the existing dated inventory entry and NOTICE rather than replacing the published CSV or hiding the prior narrative; the artifact hash and field counts remain stable.
